latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 4K Free Video – export and edit videos in 4K for free.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM clips (up to 500MB).
- Export high-resolution 4K MP4 videos without watermarks or fees.
- Includes cloud-based GPU rendering, fast processing, and automatic timeline management.
- Session-based workflow: supports uploading, editing, and exporting, with status and credits checking.
- Designed for YouTubers and fast creators; works without premium subscriptions or extra configuration.
